metadata.name: MealPrep
metadata.description: A React Native Expo application for meal planning, grocery management, and nutritional tracking

overview.purpose: MealPrep is a comprehensive meal planning and grocery management application that helps users: - Plan meals across breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks - Track ingredients with proportional quantity calculations - Manage grocery shopping lists - Log meal history with nutritional details - Set personal nutritional goals - Support dark/light theme with system preference detection

feature.name: Meal Planning
feature.description: Create and organize meals into sections with individual ingredient items. Each meal can have multiple sections and items with customizable quantities, units, and proportional weights.

feature.name: Meal Selection
feature.description: Visual interface to select meals and ingredients from predefined meal plans. Includes ingredient picker with 9+ categories and 100+ ingredients.

feature.name: Grocery Management
feature.description: Create and manage shopping lists with item names, quantities, units, and checklist functionality.

feature.name: History Tracking
feature.description: Log consumed meals with date, meal type, ingredients, and personal notes. View historical meal data.

feature.name: User Profile
feature.description: Store and manage user information including name, age, weight, height, and daily nutritional goals (calories, protein, carbs, fat).

feature.name: Theme System
feature.description: Support for light and dark modes with system preference detection and user override options.

feature.name: Modal Panels
feature.description: Global modal management system for ingredient pickers, confirmations, and other overlay components.

pattern.name: State Management
pattern.description: React Context API with AsyncStorage persistence for global application state
pattern.implementation: - ProfileProvider: User profile and settings - IngredientsProvider: Meal planning state - HistoryProvider: Meal history tracking - useGroceries hook: Grocery list management - PanelProvider: Modal/panel state management
pattern.persistence: All providers implement a hydration pattern: 1. Load state from AsyncStorage on mount 2. Skip first save after hydration (hasEverSavedRef) 3. Save any subsequent state changes 4. Handle cleanup with alive flag for unmounted components

pattern.name: Component Architecture
pattern.description: Hierarchical component structure with providers at root and screens in tabs
pattern.hierarchy: RootLayout (_layout.tsx) └─ MainScreen (main_screen.tsx) ├─ ProfileProvider ├─ IngredientsProvider ├─ HistoryProvider ├─ PanelProvider └─ BottomTabNavigator ├─ PlanTab ├─ MealSelectionTab ├─ GroceriesTab ├─ HistoryTab └─ ProfileTab

pattern.name: Data Persistence
pattern.storageKeys: - @profile_state_v1: User profile - @ingredients_state_v2: Meal planning data - @history_state_v1: Meal history - @groceries_state_v1: Grocery list

pattern.name: Routing
pattern.routes: / - Root layout with tab navigation /plan - Meal planning screen /meal_selection - Visual meal selector /groceries - Grocery management /history - Meal history viewer /profile - User profile settings

flow.name: Meal Planning Workflow
flow.step: 2. Ingredient Picker modal opens with 9 ingredient categories
4. Ingredient added to meal section with proportional weight

flow.name: Meal Selection Workflow
flow.step: 1. User navigates to Meal Selection tab
2. User selects breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snacks
4. User toggles ingredients to include in meal
5. Confirmation dialog created to log meal
6. Meal logged to HistoryProvider with timestamp

flow.name: Grocery Management Workflow
flow.step: 3. User enters item name, quantity, and unit
5. User can check items off as purchased
6. Clear Checked removes completed items from list

naming.rule: Components and providers use PascalCase (e.g., ProfileProvider, ConfirmationModal)
Hooks use camelCase with 'use' prefix (e.g., useProfile, useTheme, useGroceries)
Files follow kebab-case for multi-word files (e.g., panel-context.tsx, global_style.ts)
Types and interfaces use PascalCase (e.g., UserProfile, HistoryEntry, Item)

structure.rule: Each store file includes types, context, storage functions, provider, and hook in that order
Providers implement hydration pattern with isHydratingRef and hasEverSavedRef
All AsyncStorage operations are wrapped in try-catch blocks
UI components use theme colors from COLORS constant

codeStyle.rule: Use arrow functions for component and function definitions
Immutable state updates using spread operator and array methods
Comments for complex logic or non-obvious functionality

notes.note: ID generation uses Date.now() with random suffix to prevent collisions: `${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`
Proportional quantity calculation divides by totalWeight of selected items with zero-check guard
AsyncStorage hydration prevents saving incomplete data during initial load
PanelContext supports both state and data passing for modals
useTheme hook respects system theme but allows user override
